Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Role overview: 
 We’re looking for a motivated Software Developer who is ready to take on maintenance and incremental development work in C++, C#, and JavaScript for a complex university platform (timetabling, scheduling, attendance, room booking). The role also includes using and extending existing AI tools within the SCDL workflow, with guidance and full support from the client. 
 Technologies overview: 
C++ / C++Builder / Embarcadero 
C# / .NET Framework 4.x / ASP.NET MVC 
.NET / ASP.NET Core 
JS/ Angular 8–19 
SQL Server 
Deployment: Windows installers and Azure DevOps CI/CD 
Repos & pipelines: Azure DevOps 
 What you’ll do: 
Gradually take ownership of maintaining and evolving existing platform components (C++, C#/.NET, JavaScript/Angular) used by universities for timetabling, scheduling, attendance, and room booking 
Investigate, troubleshoot, and optimize legacy modules developed in C++/C++Builder and .NET Framework / ASP.NET MVC components 
Contribute to the gradual modernization of the system, including migrating relevant elements to .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core and Angular 
Implement and extend AI capabilities already initiated, with direct support from the client 
Develop workflows, AI agents, and proof-of-concepts to validate new ideas and technologies 
Work with LLMs, vector databases, RAG patterns, evaluation tools, and orchestration frameworks to build robust and reusable AI solutions 
Build accelerators, components, and reusable templates for company-wide AI initiatives 
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand business problems and quickly prototype functional solutions 
Document and actively contribute to AI playbooks, best practices, internal processes, and experimentation guidelines 
Monitor AI ecosystem developments and translate emerging capabilities into actionable recommendations for the platform 
Use Azure DevOps for repository management, CI/CD pipelines, and deployments (including Windows installers) 
 What we’re looking for: 
5 years of experience as .NET Software developer 
Practical experience working with core web technologies (JavaScript, HTML, CSS) 
Practical experience working with Aurelia, Angular, Linting 
Familiar with C++ and open to expanding hands-on C++ expertise using coding assistants 
Good understanding of: Best practices, Code quality, Defensive programming 
Experience with unit/ integration tests 
Experience with Azure DevOps CI/ CD pipelines 
Docker experience 
OWASP 
Experience with authentication / authorization 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field 
Solid understanding of prompt engineering fundamentals and basic data preprocessing techniques 
Ability to work with pre-trained foundation models (e.g., GPT, Llama, Gemini) 
Hands-on experience using AI-assisted code completion tools 
Practical experience with AI-augmented development workflows 
General awareness of Model Context Protocol (MCP) concepts 
Awareness of open-source AI models and associated tooling 
Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn emerging AI frameworks and best practices 
 Nice to have: 
Identity Server experience 
Participation in competitive programming, coding challenges, or mathematics olympiads, and showing strong problem-solving skills and a drive for excellence 
 About Yonder: Yonder has been developing software for over 33 years, for the most prominent software companies. Collaboration is key, with the product software company as domain specialist and Yonder as technology specialist. In our team we are fully responsible for the technical solutions and quality of the delivery, while we manage to keep a very strong relationship with the client and you’re a key player in doing so.
 Apply now or get in touch with us to find out more information! 
 *Please note that by applying to this role you are informed about your personal data being processed by Yonder for this role and for future ones.You can find more details about our policy here.
